findings.obs_text: In Act 18:4 and Act 19:8 persuade (G3982) stands beside the reasoning (G1256), six and two words after it, joined by and: the reasoning and the persuading are one activity in the synagogue. WordNet relates the subgroup to this collection through argue, a synonym; the verses show the pairing with persuade instead.
findings.grounds: tried to persuade Jews and Greeks

findings.obs_text: In Act 18:14 wrongdoing (G0092) and crime (G4467) stand in the condition before reason: Gallio would have a ground to hear the complaint only if a wrong or a crime were in question; the reason depends on the offence.
findings.grounds: a matter of wrongdoing or vicious crime

findings.obs_text: In Gen 41:31 and Gen 47:13 severe (H3515) describes the famine that by reason of names as the cause: the severity of the famine is what makes it a cause, of plenty forgotten and of the land wasting.
findings.grounds: the famine was very severe

findings.obs_text: In 1Sa 20:29 favor (H2580) stands five words before for this reason, inside the request it sums up: David asks leave on the condition of having found favor, and that request is the cause given for his absence.
findings.grounds: if I have found favor in your eyes

findings.obs_text: In Act 24:25 will (G3333, summon) stands seventeen words after reasoned, in Felix's reply: the reasoning ends with Felix sending Paul away and promising to call him later; the words are not joined.
findings.grounds: I will summon you

findings.obs_text: In Act 28:18 wished (G1014) stands four words before reason, and the reason clause gives its ground: the wish to free Paul rests on there being no cause for death.
findings.grounds: they wished to set me at liberty

older.finding: the will weighed against another's (Pilate wishing to satisfy the crowd, Mar 15:15)
older.reason: it states how the will works against another's will; it reads the desire words

findings.obs_text: In 1Jo 3:8 destroy (G3089) stands five words after the reason, in the clause it introduces: the purpose of the appearing of the Son of God is the destroying of the devil's works.
findings.grounds: to destroy the works of the devil

findings.obs_text: In Num 18:32 die (H4191) closes the warning of the next sentence, eight words after the reason phrase and not joined to it.
findings.grounds: lest you die

findings.obs_text: In Jos 5:4 died (H4191) stands in the explanation the reason introduces: the death of the generation that came out of Egypt is the cause of the new circumcision.
findings.grounds: had died in the wilderness

findings.obs_text: In Jam 3:17 sincere (G0505) closes the list of the qualities of wisdom that open to reason belongs to, seven places after it; they are joined only by the list.
findings.grounds: impartial and sincere

findings.obs_text: In Num 18:32 bear (H5375J) opens the verse, two words before by reason of it: the giver will carry no sin, and the reason phrase gives why.
findings.grounds: you shall bear no sin by reason of it

findings.obs_text: In 1Th 3:5 bear (G4722) stands two words after for this reason, in the clause of the cause: Paul could no longer endure not knowing, and so he sent.
findings.grounds: when I could bear it no longer

findings.obs_text: In 1Ti 1:16 patience (G3115) stands nine words after for this reason, in the purpose it introduces: the mercy was given so that Christ's patience might be shown.
findings.grounds: his perfect patience

findings.obs_text: In 1Th 3:5 tempted (G3985G) stands eleven words after for this reason, in the fear that moved the sending: the cause of the sending includes the worry that the tempter had tempted them.
findings.grounds: the tempter had tempted you

findings.obs_text: In Mar 12:24 wrong (G4105) stands directly after the reason: the reason is the cause of the error, and the error is named at once.
findings.grounds: the reason you are wrong

findings.obs_text: In Act 19:9 speaking evil (G2551) stands nine words before reasoning: the slander of the Way by some is part of what moved Paul to withdraw and reason elsewhere.
findings.grounds: speaking evil of the Way

findings.obs_text: In Gen 47:13 languished (H3856A) stands directly before by reason of: the wasting of the land is the effect, and the famine named after it is the cause.
findings.grounds: languished by reason of the famine

findings.obs_text: In Job 1:9 fear (H3372H) stands two words before for no reason: Satan's question asks whether Job's fear of God has no ground behind it; the fear is what the reason is questioned of.
findings.grounds: Does Job fear God for no reason

findings.obs_text: In Act 24:25 alarmed (G1719) stands ten words after reasoned: Felix becomes afraid while Paul reasons about righteousness, self-control and the judgment to come; the alarm follows the content of the reasoning.
findings.grounds: Felix was alarmed

older.finding: the fear of God tested by what is withheld (Gen 22:12) and questioned (Job 1:9)
older.reason: it states how the fear of God is tested; it reads the fear words

findings.obs_text: In Gen 41:31 plenty (H7647) opens the verse, three words before by reason of: the plenty is what will be forgotten, and the famine named after the reason phrase is why.
findings.grounds: the plenty will be unknown in the land

findings.obs_text: In Dan 4:36 was established (H8627) stands fifteen words after reason, at the end of a sequence that begins with its return: reason, then glory, then the counselors' seeking, then the king set again in his kingdom.
findings.grounds: I was established in my kingdom
